title: Where We Are in the AI Cycle

reader_summary.headline: People are still trying to figure out how everything works.
reader_summary.overview: People are still trying to figure out how everything works. What I love about the vibe writing concept actually is it's a place in which full autonomy can be fulfilled today. You're prompting, although it's English-like, it turns out you're just programming.

thesis: The speakers argue that the current stage of the AI cycle is comparable to the 64K IBM PC era, characterized by users still trying to figure out how the technology works and significant limitations in its practical application. They distinguish between 'vibe coding,' which faces early constraints and security risks requiring human oversight, and 'vibe writing,' which offers a place for full autonomy today by shifting the user's role from writer to editor.
